q: Are you passionate about e-commerce technology, system optimization, and finding smarter ways to improve online shopping platforms?

We’re looking for an E-Commerce System Administrator who understands that a successful online shopping experience goes beyond what customers see on the website. It's about managing the systems behind it, optimizing backend functionalities, ensuring seamless integrations, and keeping every digital touchpoint running smoothly.
What You Bring to the Table
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in e-commerce systems administration or website platform management.
Hands-on experience with Magento and Shopify , including backend administration and configuration.
Good understanding of CMS, PIM, product management, and e-commerce functionalities.
Experience with system integrations, APIs, and technical troubleshooting.
Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and basic web development concepts.
Experience with UAT, system testing, bug tracking, and platform enhancements.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.
Fluent in English; Arabic is a plus.
Join a growing e-commerce business where technology meets retail. Take ownership of key digital platforms, work on impactful system enhancements, and help shape a seamless online shopping experience.
If you have the technical expertise and e-commerce platform experience we're looking for, we'd love to hear from you.
r: Manage E-Commerce Platforms: Administer and maintain Magento and Shopify platforms, including backend configurations, system settings, product management, categories, and navigation.
Keep the Platform Running: Monitor website functionality, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure smooth day-to-day e-commerce operations.
Make Campaigns Happen: Configure promotions, discounts, vouchers, banners, and campaign setups within the platforms.
Optimize System Functionality: Manage platform enhancements, backend updates, integrations, and new feature implementations.
Test Before You Launch: Conduct UAT, troubleshoot bugs, validate system changes, and coordinate with developers to ensure successful deployments.
Connect Systems & Teams: Work closely with developers, IT, marketing, and merchandising teams to resolve issues and improve platform performance.

d: The Outbound Virtual RM (Individual Contributor) plays a critical role in amplifying the WRB Contact Centre’s ambition to deliver an “International Wealth Manager” experience, servicing multi-market relationships and treating every client interaction as an opportunity to create value.

The Virtual Outbound RM will serve local and premium client segments on a non-cross-border basis. It proactively engages clients through outbound channels to contribute to relationship deepening, product adoption and revenue growth, while maintaining high standards of customer experience, conduct and regulatory compliance. The role is primarily responsible for executing wealth and product advisory and updates, sales engagement, and lead generation (licensed activity). Virtual Outbound RMs will support the Bank’s strategic shift to service to sales, insight led engagement and relationship based value creation. It will specifically identify sales opportunities, and cross-selling/upselling the Bank’s products and services through the execution of strong relationship building and communication skills.

All WRB Contact Centre colleagues will be measured against these 5 KPIs: high-quality service, value creation, talent development, digital enablement and operational efficiency. All role holders will also be expected to demonstrate these valued behaviours in the delivery of responsibilities: client centricity, innovation, and collaboration.
q: Motivated by recognising different client needs, preferences and life stages, and adapting conversations accordingly to help clients make informed decisions about their products and wealth.
Energised by working in a target‑driven but relationship‑focused environment, where the quality of client engagement matters as much as volume to influence commercial outcomes.
Operating in a fast-evolving digital and AI-enabled sales environment where new tools, data and insights continually shape how client engagement is prioritised and delivered.
Proven experience in outbound brand and/or telesales with exposure to general banking, retail operations, lending products, and audit requirements.
Demonstrable client servicing / client relationship management track record within a regulated environment.
Demonstrable experience of working in a deadline and KPI-driven organisation.

r: Deliver a high quality client service by handling client queries on product sign-ups and providing additional information on products and promotion sign-up processes, in line with KPIs and targets.

Support the function’s digital enablement by monitoring automated services within the remit of wealth/product advisory and updates, including personalised financial and wealth planning, investment and product discovery and education, loyalty, rewards, and product promotion awareness.
Ensure operational efficiency and issue resolution by promptly redirecting specialised queries to specialists, RMs or branches where required, in service of enhancing the client experience.

Support the function’s value creation efforts by converting inbound or prior service interactions into outbound engagement opportunities, through pitching financial solutions based on clients’ financial needs.

Contribute to net new money growth and profitable growth of the affluent portfolio by capitalising on cross-sell opportunities that meet clients’ needs and building rapport with clients through personalised, needs‑based conversations (rather than product‑driven selling).
Redirect clients to relevant licensed channels for further processing and sales conversions, for those countries with regulatory restrictions.

Prioritise outreach, tailor conversations and improve hit‑rates through using digitally-enabled tools and technologies (CRM systems, agentic AI, speech analytics, guided workflows, insights, and quality monitoring).
Leverage real-time data-driven insights on client behaviour, preferences and lifecycle triggers to guide outbound interactions
Improve service quality and productivity by demonstrating learning agility and continuously building confidence and capability in new digital, AI and agentic tools.

Maintain strong risk and compliance discipline by complying with the Bank’s mis-selling and sales policies, and policies related to ORMA, the Group Code of Conduct, KYC/CDD/EDD and money laundering prevention.

Execute outbound activity fully in line with conduct, suitability, consent, privacy and regulatory standards. This includes maintaining accurate records of client interactions, offers and outcomes to support audit, governance and reporting requirements.
Apply judgement to determine when not to sell, including recognising signs of client vulnerability and identifying when a proposition is not in the client’s best interests.
